correctness.rationale: Gaussian Fock monomial diagonalization for radial symbols gives the exact Gamma(k+d,1) eigenvalue formula and multiplicities C(k+d−1,d−1). Gamma concentration plus derivative O(t^(−d−1)) gives eigenvalues k^(−d)(b+φ(loglog k))+O(k^(−d−1/2)), with absolutely summable errors after multiplicities. Eventual strict decrease of the radial symbol and Gamma stochastic coupling place all sufficiently large degree blocks in decreasing singular order. The weighted harmonic sum becomes b log K+∫₁^K φ(loglog x)dx/x; substitution yields exactly log K times G_φ(loglog K). The multiplicity count B_K~K^d/d! converts it to (b+G_φ(loglog N−log d))/d!. Translation-invariant logarithmic-ultrafilter averages realize all phases and all values in the closed range as dilation-invariant generalized limits; G′+G=φ makes measurability equivalent to constant φ. For sin input the filter is (sin v−cos v)/2 and Fourier mode factor (1+ik)^(−1). No finite quadrature substitutes for the proof.
